caption_L1: Here a is a bar plot named Number of registered ice hockey players in Finland from 2010/11 to 2019/20. caption_L2L3: 2016/2017 saw the highest number of registered hockey players and 2011/2012 saw the fewest. Apart from 2011/2012 there was a consistent number of over 60000 players registered. 2013 to 2018 saw relatively small changes in numbers.
